module.name: kind_cluster_register_existing
module.description: Reference an existing kind cluster on the local Docker daemon (or a remote host via DOCKER_HOST) and emit BNK cluster-registration outputs.

optional.name: cluster_name
optional.description: Name of the existing kind cluster.

optional.name: ssh_user
optional.description: Optional SSH user from a bare-metal credential template; combined with ssh_host into DOCKER_HOST=ssh://user@host.

optional.name: ssh_host
optional.description: Optional SSH host from a bare-metal credential template; combined with ssh_user into DOCKER_HOST=ssh://user@host.

optional.name: docker_host
optional.description: Optional explicit DOCKER_HOST override. Takes precedence over ssh_user/ssh_host.

key_outputs.name: cluster_id
key_outputs.description: Cluster ID alias for BNK registration.
